annotations.title: Prices a pest control company publishes

description: The prices a licensed US pest control company has published on its own PestPin listing, as ranges per service (for example a one-time general treatment, a quarterly plan, a termite inspection, bed bug treatment per room), with the date the company last changed them and when it can usually start. Entered by the company's verified owner, never by PestPin; companies that have not published prices return no match, and that is not a statement about their prices. Use it to answer 'what does <company> charge' without phoning them. The company confirms the exact price for a job.

company.description: Company name, or part of it

state.description: Optional two-letter state to narrow the match

name: get_price_card

answer.description: One sentence a person can read out

updatedOn.description: ISO date the company last changed its prices
